title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalammlakm wa-rahmatullaahi wa barkaatuhu. Respected Sir. I have doubt about jamat-ka-kaam? Because our nabi(sallellahu-alhiva-sallem)not performed / suggested this kind of work? Upto what level it is correct ? is it meet/related to any ayaat in quraan /hadees ? Please give proper awnser because i am also started going in 3-din jamat just to protect myself,learn something related to deen and to make aakhirat-ki tayaari . 2845 views Q. I have a question regarding the effort of Tabligh. Recently in our Masjid, we have had an alim who joins mashwera, and he is adamant that when brothers are going out for gusht, only dawah for salaah should be given, if the person is not coming salaah, or only dawah for taleem should be given, if the person comes for salaah but doesn?t sit on taleem. The elders in the mashwera wouldn?t say anything but also would not carry out the advice. I spoke to one the 4 month brothers about this and he says that full 6 points dawah should be given as this is the advice from the elders. He said the reason no-one says anything is because he in an alim and when the alim last spent time, it over about 15 years ago, and the elders have changed what they were saying 15 years ago to now. What is the correct method? 2883 views Q. Aslam o alaikum. I am a student in medical college.Thr is a problem with me tht i m irresponsible.i belong to a rich family so i did nt care before from where the money was comin and which way i wasting . So my studies were affected by this atitude.wht does islam say abt this act of irresponsibilty and nt caring for the money sent to me by my parents. Any punishment for thir irresponsible person. If i think to run my family and fulfilling thr rights is it against tawkul or yaqeen. I m asking this cuz my life changed due to tableegh.then i was offering my prayers and going in the way of Allah but i was weaker towards my studies,no interest.later when i consulted psychotherapist he said it is because of irresponsible attitude towards future,ur duties.plz answer my question in detail so i can act more responsible and keep balance b/w deen and duniya. 1755 views Q. Some popular singer in Pakistan has recently the Tableeghi Jama'at. A friend of mine the other day argued with that since the singer has earned money through a haram activity, that is to say, through singing, he first of all should get rid of his harmam money and then he should join the Tableeghi Jama'at, and do the Tableegh. I just could not satisfy him. Please guide me in this connection as to he should get rid of his haram money first, and then should join Tableegh? Or should he do it without getting rid of that haram money? 2223 views Q. Currently I am making up all my missed Saums (Fasting ) from the previous years. Now,in the 3rd week of Dec'2007,I am going for 40 Days Jamat, InshaAllah. Now, on those 40 days, shall I keep "Nafl Roza Intention" or keep making up my "missed Saum Intention." Please advise ? I was reading this Hadith, so the above question came to my mind. "Whoever keeps fast for one day while out in the path of Allah, Allah will (certainly) keep him from the fire of Jahannam a distance of seventy years in place of that one day. (Bukhaari and Muslim) ------------ Also please advise Top 5 things (Amaal) I should do in my 40 Days Jamat. 1861 views Q. Did the holy Prophet Muhammad (SAW) send any caravan for Muslims rectifications (islah) while the time of Nubuwwat period. 5103 views Q. As a child I was educated in convent English schools. Due to our ignorance we used to say prayers in school which today I feel was Shirk. For e.g. one of our prayers was "Jesus hear us, we pray .. Keep us safe through this day..... Jesus Lord hear our pray may we rest in thy care" Similarly as teenagers due to our ignorance we used to participate with Hindus praying to their idols during varios festivals. all this was grave shirk as i realized today. since the time I realized this, I have not been able to have peace of mind and constantly ask Allah for forgiveness in prayers. But is there something which I should do so that my heart and soul are free from the guilt of the grave sin committed in childhood and teenage. Please guide me. Allah hafiz Thank you 2681 views Q. foreign jamath 3288 views Q. How must a muslim person treat his parents if they are murtad? 5293 views Q. GAIR / NON MUSLIM KO ISLAM KI DAWAT KIS TARAH DE?
